riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine numerical accuracy, steadiness, and firm boundaries: documents must be correct, rules must hold, and risks must be stopped.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most demanding standard in this work is accuracy: one missed income check or fraudulent document can lead to a bad loan. It suits steady people who are comfortable with numbers and can remain focused during repetition. Compliance awareness is also essential.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers organized, rule-based work while also engaging with people (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Social S).

breadcrumb.label: 信贷授权员、核查员、文员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「数字准 + 性子稳 + 守底线」凑一块的人——材料要对，规则要硬，风险要拦。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「准」——一条收入漏核、一个假证明就可能放笔坏账。适合性子稳、数字敏感、能在重复里保持专注的人，合规意识也是硬指标。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿和人打交道（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: To test your fit, ask yourself: can you spend three hours researching which tariff code applies to one component?
riasec_fit_block.interest: Able to focus for long periods and inspect details, sensitive to regulatory language, and willing to trace every declaration's classification basis precisely.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Conventional (C) · Enterprising (E) · Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 想知道自己适不适合，先问：你能为「一个零件到底算哪个税则号」翻三小时资料吗？
riasec_fit_block.interest: 坐得住、抠得细，对法规条文敏感，愿意把每一单的归类依据研究到小数点。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 常规型 C · 企业型 E · 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about data-entry work and accept judgment under operational risk, Data Entry Keyers can be worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field teaches that accuracy matters more than speed. Data Entry Keyers need fast hands without shifting rows when fatigue sets in. It suits people who are meticulous, can remain seated, and tolerate repetitive work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers structure and order, with an interest in verification and hands-on work (Conventional C + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Data Entry Keyers有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，数据录入员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「准比快重要」——既要手速，也要在疲劳里不串行。适合细心、坐得住、对重复不烦躁的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好规范秩序、也讲核对与动手（常规 C + 研究 I + 现实 R）。

breadcrumb.label: Earth Drillers, Except Oil And Gas

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines field work, machinery, and geology. Workers must operate rigs and interpret cores.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The exciting part is never knowing what the next meter will reveal. Hard rock requires another bit; an aquifer requires a drilling-fluid adjustment. Each day combines physical effort with judgment and suits people who prefer outdoor work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 土方钻探工、石油天然气

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「野外 + 机械 + 地质」凑一块的人——开得动钻机，也看得懂岩芯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带感的是「你永远不知道下一米会钻到什么」。岩层变硬要换钻头，遇到含水层要调泥浆配比，一天下来既有体力消耗也有脑子判断，适合坐不住、喜欢在野外的性子。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines principles, analytical judgment, and field stamina. Compliance decisions must be firm and precise, while company communication must lead to action.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career rewards careful work within clear rules. Inspectors need strong knowledge of regulations and standards, plus the resolve to achieve results across companies and field sites. It suits principled people who can concentrate at a desk, work on site, and follow a case from investigation through closure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「原则 + 理性 + 能跑腿」凑一块的人——达标要硬也要准，企业要做通也要办成。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「规矩里的较真」——既要懂法规和标准算得清，也要有在企业和现场之间把事办成的硬气。适合讲原则、坐得住、又愿意跑现场的人，也享受从排查到闭环的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、规矩、也务实（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with a genuine connection to mountains and forests. The work centers on the forest itself, not titles or high income.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this work comes from knowing a mountain over time. Workers see the same slopes bud in spring and change color in autumn. They know which stands are thriving and where pests are spreading. The forest does not speak, but experienced workers can read its condition.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 森林与自然保护从业人员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合对山野有真感情的人——你爱的是这片林子本身，而不是它带来的头衔或收入。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的浪漫在「和山打交道」：同一个山头，你看着它春天发芽、秋天变黄，知道哪片林子今年长得好、哪片又在闹虫。森林不跟你说话，但它的状态你一眼就懂。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with deep curiosity, strong logic, and patience for long research cycles. Finding biological patterns in ATCG data is the intellectual reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this career lies in exploring life's underlying logic. Research on inherited disease and genetic intervention can affect patients and families. It suits people who enjoy sustained inquiry across biology and computation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative + Conventional + Realistic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「好奇心重、逻辑强、坐得住冷板凳」的人——在 ATCG 四字母里找出生命的规律，就是遗传学家的浪漫。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「探索生命的底层逻辑」：为什么有人得这种病、怎么从基因层面干预，你的研究可能改变一个人、一个家庭的命运。喜欢钻研、能坐冷板凳、又对生物和计算都感兴趣的人，会在这里找到科研人的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 常规型 C + 实际型 R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This industry is suitable for people who combine "on-site + people management + pressure handling" - they can sort out priorities in chaos and lead a group of people.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This line of work requires "coordination" the most - if one line stops, the entire delivery schedule will be messed up. Can you rearrange it within half an hour and save it? Suitable for people who love the scene, can handle pressure, and can manage people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Preference is for corporate decision-making and pragmatism (Enterprise E + Conventional C + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「现场 + 管人 + 扛压」凑一块的人——能在混乱里理出优先级，也带得动一班人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「统筹」——一条线停了，整张交付表就乱，你能不能在半小时内重新排布救回来。适合爱现场、扛得住压力、又能管人的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好重企业决策、也务实动手（企业 E + 常规 C + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who make thinking clearly, explaining precisely, and writing rigorously a way of life. Law uses a precise conceptual system to analyze the real world, and both the classroom and the desk extend that intellectual work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal lies in the long horizon of ideas. A legal principle introduced in class can appear five years later in a former student's advocacy, and seeing a graduate student surpass the teacher is a distinctive reward of academic work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「想清楚、讲明白、写下来」当生活方式的人——法学的乐趣在于用一套精密的概念体系拆解真实世界，而讲台和书桌都是这种乐趣的延伸。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在于「思想的长期主义」：你在课堂上埋下的一颗法理种子，可能五年后在一个律师的辩护词里发芽；带的研究生做出了你没想到的成果，那种「学生超越老师」的时刻，是学术职业独有的回报。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who love dramas and variety shows and can negotiate ad placements with clients. Content taste and commercial instincts are equally essential.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The thrill comes from making the right bet. When your schedule raises ratings and advertising prices, results are visible. It suits people who enjoy data and content bets and compete daily for audience attention.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「既爱追剧看综艺、又能跟广告客户掰扯投放」的人——内容品味和商业嗅觉缺一不可。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带感的地方是「押对了就赢」：你排的节目收视涨了、广告卖上价了，成就感直接可见。适合喜欢看数据、又爱赌内容口味的人，每天跟用户抢遥控器过招。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 企业型 E + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine inquiry, systems thinking, and resilience under yield pressure. Dimensions must be calculated clearly and packaged successfully, balancing devices and processes through integration.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops systems thinking at microscopic dimensions. Engineers must understand processes and devices and coordinate the integration of mechanical, electronic, and optical functions. It suits inquisitive, focused people willing to take responsibility for yield who enjoy the closed loop from design through tape-out.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and creativity (Enterprising I + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「钻研 + 系统 + 能扛良率」凑一块的人——尺寸要算得清也要封得动，器件和工艺要平衡也要会拧。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「尺寸里的系统感」——既要懂工艺和器件，也要有把机械、电子、光学拧一块的统筹。适合钻研、坐得住、又愿意对良率负责的人，也享受从设计到流片的闭环。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也创造（企业 I + 现实 R + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Plating Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits compliant, attentive, patient people. Coating quality affects part life and appearance, making craftsmanship visible.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this field lies in precise surface treatment. The quality of plating on identical parts creates enormous differences in life and appearance. People who value stability, follow rules, work well with their hands, and tolerate chemical workshops find a grounded technical trade here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「守规矩、细心、有耐心」的人——镀层做得好不好，关系到零件的寿命和外观，你的手艺看得见。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「把表面处理做精」：同一种零件，镀得好不好，寿命和外观天差地别。喜欢稳定、守规矩、动手能力强、能适应化学车间的人，会在这里找到技术工种的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine empathy, calmness, and rigor. They must absorb emotions, make decisions, and carry risk.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops judgment under uncertainty. You need knowledge of neuroscience and pharmacology, the ability to absorb emotions, and the strength to carry risk. It suits empathetic, calm people who tolerate gradual progress.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, helping others, and decisive action (Investigative I + Social S + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「共情 + 冷静 + 严谨」凑一块的人——情绪要接得住，判断也要下得去，风险还要扛得起。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在不确定里做判断」——既要懂脑科学和药理，也要接得住情绪、扛得住风险。适合共情强、冷静、又耐得住慢的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、助人、也善断（研究 I + 社会 S + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine practicality, procedural discipline, and composure. Process media must be transferred safely and steadily, balancing procedures and judgment with hands-on ability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is steadiness and attention to detail. Operators must remain focused in a roaring pump room and stay sensitive to pressure curves and alarms. It suits practical, procedure-oriented, composed people who enjoy the reassurance of keeping an entire system operating reliably.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical hands-on, procedural, and orderly work (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 守规 + 不慌」凑一块的人——介质要送得稳也要送得安全，规程和判断要平衡也要会动手。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳和细」——既要在轰鸣的泵房里坐得住，也要对压力曲线和报警信号敏感。适合务实、守规程、不慌张的人，也享受「把一整套系统稳稳当当跑起来」的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实动手、讲规程、也守规矩（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about radiation therapy and accept judgment under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops zero-tolerance precision with compassion. It requires accurate hands and the ability to reassure patients. It suits calm, meticulous, empathetic people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping and analysis while also valuing hands-on work (Social S + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Radiation Therapists有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，放射治疗师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「零容错的温柔」——既要手准，也要让病人安心。适合沉静、细致、有共情的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人与分析、也重动手（社会 S + 研究 I + 现实 R）。

breadcrumb.label: Recreation And Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people whose bodies can move and minds can become still, combining the ability to lead training with the ability to conduct research.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest pleasure in this career is keeping both scholarship and the body moving. Study how exercise improves health in the morning and test it with students on the field in the afternoon, moving seamlessly between lecture hall and activity space.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 高校休闲与健身研究教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「身体动得了、脑子静得下」的人——既能带训练，也能做研究。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最大的乐趣是「学问和身体都在动」：上午研究运动如何改善健康，下午就带着学生在操场上验证，讲台和运动场无缝切换，不闷。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine steady hands, patience at a workstation, and high quality standards. Stitching must be straight and pass inspection, requiring a balance of speed and quality.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops steadiness by hand. You need hand-eye coordination for accurate sewing and the human judgment to catch defects before garments leave the factory. It suits seated workers with steady hands who accept responsibility for quality.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be practical, conventional, and helpful (Realistic R + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 坐得住 + 对质量较真」凑一块的人——线迹要踩得齐也要过得检，手速和质量要平衡也要会看。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的稳定」——既要手眼协调踩得准，也要有把疵点卡在出厂前的人情。适合坐得住、手稳、愿意对质量负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、也常规、也助人（现实 R + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine pragmatism, steadiness, and vigilance. Systems must supply energy reliably and be tuned accurately, while parameters and safety require balanced oversight.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops meticulous attention within complex systems. You need to understand thermal and mechanical systems and remain composed when alarms sound. It suits pragmatic, steady people willing to take responsibility for continuous operations and who enjoy the complete process from inspection to reliable supply.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, Conventional, and Investigative preferences (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

breadcrumb.label: 固定设备工程师与锅炉操作员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 稳重 + 能守」凑一块的人——系统要供得稳也要调得准，参数和安全要平衡也要会守。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「系统里的细心」——既要懂热力与机械，也要在报警响起时稳住处置。适合务实、稳重、又愿意对连续运行负责的人，也享受从巡检到保供的完整过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守规、也重精确（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine composure, steady hands, and aesthetic judgment. Stone must be carved correctly, and both patterns and details depend on people.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops hands-on craftsmanship. Workers must understand drawings and calculate stone use while patiently carving veining correctly. It suits focused, hands-on people willing to wrestle with stone who enjoy the tangible satisfaction of seeing a piece take shape.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer hands-on work, creativity, and leadership (Realistic R + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 石材切割与雕刻工（制造类）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「沉稳 + 手稳 + 有审美」凑一块的人——石头要雕对，纹路和细节都靠人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的功夫」——既要懂图纸和石材算得清，也要有把纹路雕对的耐心。适合沉得下心、动手强、又愿意和石头较劲的人，也享受一件作品成型的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、创造、也主导（实际 R + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about timing device assembly and adjustment and do not avoid judgment under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops hands that remain steady even under a microscope. Workers must understand movement structures, tolerate prolonged stillness and repetition, and keep errors within seconds. It suits dexterous, calm perfectionists.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and order (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 计时装置装配与调校工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Timing Device Assemblers And Adjusters有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，计时装置装配与调校工值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「显微镜下也手不抖」——既要读得懂机芯结构，也要耐得住长时间静止与重复，还得让误差落在几秒之内。适合手巧、静得下、追求极致的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、探究、也秩序（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine attention to detail, rigor, and resilience under compliance pressure. Evidence must be clearly verified and investigated thoroughly, while the work requires balancing regulations, hands-on execution, and strong writing.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops rigor grounded in evidence. You need to understand processes and regulations while insisting on investigating every deviation fully. It suits meticulous, patient people willing to take responsibility for compliance and who value completing the full cycle from protocol to release.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, investigative, and creative preferences (Enterprising I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 严谨 + 能扛合规」凑一块的人——证据要查得清也要追得底，法规和动手要平衡也要会写。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「证据里的严谨」——既要懂工艺和法规，也要有把每个偏差查到底的较真。适合细致、坐得住、又愿意对合规负责的人，也享受从方案到放行的闭环。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也创造（企业 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about veterinary medicine and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to make decisions for animals that cannot speak. Veterinarians must understand tests and images, withstand emergencies and loss, and explain medical expertise to anxious owners. It suits compassionate people with steady nerves and strong hands-on ability.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative, realistic, and social (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Veterinarians有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，其他职业值得考虑。
